caption: The video captures a calm, narrow waterway threading through a dense mangrove forest, where murky brown-green water fills the lower frame and mirrors the trunks and overhead foliage. Slender, gnarled trunks rise from the water on the right and recede into the distance, while leafy branches arch in from the left beneath a bright overcast sky patch in the upper-left canopy. The viewpoint drifts slowly forward through the channel, so the right-side trunks and the left overhanging branch shift slightly toward the frame edges. The bright sky opening narrows a little as more canopy fills the top, yet the overall composition, lighting, and water color remain essentially unchanged. Water-surface reflections ripple and distort subtly, while the apparent waterline on the trunks stays roughly steady. No people or boats appear; the persistent dynamic is this slow forward drift and gentle surface ripple.
